subject: necromantic pearl
fact: The necromantic pearl is smooth, dense, fist-sized, and has a weight that feels unnatural for something grown.
source_quote: Smooth. Dense. Fist-sized. The weight of it was wrong for something grown — too even, too finished, like a stone that had been worked by a hand that knew what it was doing.

subject: necromantic pearl
fact: The necromantic pearl emits a sensation like standing next to a door that opens into a room you don't want to know about.
source_quote: And the sensation coming off it wasn't heat or cold exactly. More like standing next to a door that opens into a room you don't want to know about.

subject: necromantic pearl
fact: Thorin pockets the necromantic pearl after finding it in the fungal core.
source_quote: I didn't need a name for it. It was worth something to the right buyer, and I was not going to leave anything useful in this cavern, so I pocketed it.

subject: chamber
fact: The chamber contains a fungal mass at its center, a stone platform covered in pulsing fungal growth, and dead guards.
source_quote: The fungal mass sat at the center of the chamber... The bundle was underneath... The guards hadn't survived

subject: chamber
fact: The chamber has a stone platform that was built by Ilvara and covered in fungal growth.
source_quote: Ilvara had built herself something elevated... the fungal growth that had crept up the stone was still pulsing with Zuggtmoy's reach

subject: leather-wrapped bundle
fact: The leather-wrapped bundle contains incense cones, a silver bowl, and a cloth stitched with Lolth's web and Zuggtmoy's mark.
source_quote: Inside: incense cones, a silver bowl small enough to fit in one hand, and a cloth that had been stitched with two sigils — Lolth's web worked into the eight-fold geometry of Zuggtmoy's mark, one woven inside the other.

subject: silver bowl
fact: The silver bowl is small enough to fit in one hand.
source_quote: a silver bowl small enough to fit in one hand

subject: cloth with sigils
fact: The cloth is stitched with Lolth's web woven inside the eight-fold geometry of Zuggtmoy's mark.
source_quote: a cloth that had been stitched with two sigils — Lolth's web worked into the eight-fold geometry of Zuggtmoy's mark, one woven inside the other.

subject: gold
fact: Thorin takes gold from the bodies of the dead guards.
source_quote: Gold, short swords, a long sword, a steel whistle.

subject: short swords
fact: Thorin takes short swords from the bodies of the dead guards.
source_quote: Gold, short swords, a long sword, a steel whistle.

subject: long sword
fact: Thorin takes a long sword from the bodies of the dead guards.
source_quote: Gold, short swords, a long sword, a steel whistle.

subject: steel whistle
fact: Thorin takes a steel whistle from the bodies of the dead guards.
source_quote: Gold, short swords, a long sword, a steel whistle.

subject: signet ring
fact: The signet ring found on the mage bears the seal of House T'sarran.
source_quote: I found the signet ring first — House T'sarran, the seal unmistakable on the face of it.

subject: wand
fact: The wand is made of obsidian with a captive spider preserved in amber at its tip.
source_quote: Then the wand: obsidian, a captive spider preserved in amber at its tip.

subject: documents
fact: The documents were partially burned but still legible in places.
source_quote: The documents. They'd been partially burned, which meant someone had tried to destroy them and hadn't quite managed it

subject: burning of documents
fact: Someone attempted to destroy the documents by burning them.
source_quote: They'd been partially burned, which meant someone had tried to destroy them and hadn't quite managed it

subject: contract to extract Daz
fact: A contract existed to extract Daz alive and unharmed, commissioned by House T'sarran.
source_quote: There had been a contract. Extract Daz alive and unharmed. House T'sarran behind it.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara collected trophies from captives, including Thorin's tooth.
source_quote: When we'd first found ourselves hanging in nets at Velkynvelve, Ilvara had made a point of collecting trophies... she'd taken my tooth.

subject: Thorin's tooth
fact: Thorin recovered his tooth, which Ilvara had taken and displayed as a trophy.
source_quote: It was settled now. I had the tooth back.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum uses acid to burn away the fungal growth on the platform.
source_quote: Grygum was not the sort to leave corruption breathing. He opened his mouth, and the acid came out clean and decisive, and the fungal matter... collapsed into ash

subject: fungal mass
fact: The fungal mass at the center of the chamber was still pulsing with Zuggtmoy's reach.
source_quote: the fungal growth that had crept up the stone was still pulsing with Zuggtmoy's reach, slow and rhythmic like breathing

subject: fungal mass
fact: The fungal mass was corrupted and had grown around the platform in the chamber.
source_quote: the fungal growth that had crept up the stone was still pulsing with Zuggtmoy's reach

subject: House Mizzrym
fact: The dead guards belonged to House Mizzrym.
source_quote: The dead soldiers of House Mizzrym would never collect their pay.

subject: House T'sarran
fact: House T'sarran commissioned the contract to extract Daz alive and unharmed.
source_quote: House T'sarran behind it.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a male Drow apostate from Menzoberranzan who studied magic.
source_quote: I am a male Drow apostate from Menzoberranzan who studied magic, held private opinions that would have gotten him killed if voiced aloud

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was the target of a contract to extract him alive and unharmed.
source_quote: Extract Daz alive and unharmed.

subject: Nym
fact: Nym becomes more expressive when irritated.
source_quote: Nym had the kind of face that gets more expressive the more irritated she becomes

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira reads the burned documents with professional focus.
source_quote: Kaelira was the opposite — still and professional, reading the burned pages with the focus of someone who was paid to be good at exactly this.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is known as Thorin Giantfriend.
source_quote: Thorin Giantfriend, radical transparency

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a sentient sunblade that refuses to be used for ritual purification.
source_quote: Dawnbringer disagreed. 'I'm not some kind of magical wizard thingy that purifies things. I am a high-quality sunblade. I kill things.'

subject: Vaultmaster Locking Scabbard
fact: Thorin uses the Vaultmaster Locking Scabbard to negotiate with Dawnbringer.
source_quote: Thorin reached, unhurriedly, for the scabbard. 'Do I need to show you the scabbard again?'

subject: Dawnbringer agreeing to purify
fact: Dawnbringer agrees to perform a purification ritual after being reminded of the scabbard.
source_quote: I suppose… I suppose I could do you this one. I could do this solid for you.

subject: Daz's true identity
fact: Daz suspects his value lies beyond his known background and is being targeted for reasons unknown.
source_quote: I am not, by any meaningful measure, a person of consequence... And yet.

subject: Ilvara's dual worship
fact: Ilvara's rituals combined Lolth's web and Zuggtmoy's mark, indicating devotion to two conflicting deities.
source_quote: a cloth that had been stitched with two sigils — Lolth's web worked into the eight-fold geometry of Zuggtmoy's mark, one woven inside the other.

subject: the necromantic pearl's origin
fact: The necromantic pearl was placed or grown in the fungal core under deliberate conditions.
source_quote: The pearl wasn't in the wrong place by accident. Someone had put something like it there, or something like it had grown there because the conditions were exactly right for it.

subject: the contract's intermediaries
fact: The contract to extract Daz was arranged through cutouts with deliberate opacity.
source_quote: The contracting party was unknown even to them. They had come specifically for me, through layers of intermediaries arranged with the kind of deliberate opacity that costs serious coin to maintain.

subject: time of Velkynvelve captivity
fact: Thorin was held captive at Velkynvelve before the current expedition.
source_quote: When we'd first found ourselves hanging in nets at Velkynvelve
